scope: Local implementation of the multi-Pine research run contract builder (docs/MULTI_PINE_CONTRACT.md 5.8, RD-MP-1, RD-MP-18) for PM-1 row F11-01: a pure builder and exact-key validator for ql3a-research-job-multi-v1 bound to a frozen member set. No storage, service, route, worker or view uses it.
method: A coder (Sonnet 5.5) wrote the module from the contract; an independent architecture auditor (Opus 5.5) reviewed round 1 and found that the rules, the capital, the evaluation cap and the sample floor did not follow the one-Pine path; root ruled; the coder fixed them; an independent tester (Sonnet 5.5) ran single-edit mutations after each round. A sole-runner tester then ran, with nothing else active, every test file that imports a changed module of this batch (found with git grep): 22 PostgreSQL files one file per process on a throwaway PostgreSQL 16.15 cluster (392 tests, 0 fail; 2 skipped by the TEMP-privilege environment gate in a file this batch did not change), the full unit suite (2214 tests, 0 fail, 6 skipped by platform gates, 9 todo) and the grant text test; every changed file had the same hash before and after. Nobody verified their own work.
hashNote: SHA-256 of the line-feed content as Git stores it.
result: test/multi-pine-run-contract.test.js 30 of 30 pass; with the member-set and package-gate tests 124 of 124; engine-hash closures unchanged.

mutations.round1: 12 of 12 killed; the import-guard mutation was skipped because it needs an edit to another file.
mutations.round2: 8 of 9 killed; the survivor (the builder rules pre-check) is equivalent because the final contract check refuses the same rules with the same field.

limits: The validator cannot recompute the set hash, the members or the capital: only the builder binds them to the frozen set.
The candidate plan, the planned candidate count and the evaluation cap are not part of this contract yet.
Capital account amounts are hashed as given; the later service must pass the server-read accounts unchanged.
No storage, service or route exists; nothing runs a multi-Pine research job.

rootAcceptance.statement: Root reviewed the agent reports, the rulings, the sole-runner verification and the final diff and accepted the run contract builder as local engineering evidence for F11-01. Acceptance changes no PM-1 credit by itself and deploys nothing.
